custom/caffeinate.tooltip: pgrep hypridle > /dev/null && echo 'Hypridle enabled' || echo 'Hypridle disabled'

actions.onLeftClick: sh -c 'if pgrep hypridle > /dev/null; then killall hypridle && notify-send -t 1000 Caffeinate "Hypridle disabled ☕"; else hypridle & notify-send -t 1000 Caffeinate "Hypridle enabled 󰒲"; fi'
